sentence: MICHAEL SANDEL: Today, we turn to the question of distributive justice.
sentence_cn: 迈克尔·桑德尔：今天，我们转向分配正义的问题。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: distributive justice 是政治哲学核心术语，指资源分配的正义原则。
def_en: relating to how things like wealth or resources are shared among people
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [00:29]

sentence: And what matters is that the hypothetical contract be carried out in an original position of equality, behind, what Rawls calls, the veil of ignorance.
sentence_cn: 关键在于，这个假设的契约要在一种平等的原初状态下订立，也就是在罗尔斯所说的“无知之幕”背后进行。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: veil of ignorance 是罗尔斯正义论的关键概念，指无知之幕。
def_en: something that hides or covers what is true or real
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [01:16]

sentence: And what matters is that the hypothetical contract be carried out in an original position of equality, behind, what Rawls calls, the veil of ignorance.
sentence_cn: 关键在于，这个假设的契约要在一种平等的原初状态下订立，也就是在罗尔斯所说的“无知之幕”背后进行。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 与 veil 构成无知之幕，是罗尔斯理论的核心假设。
def_en: the state of not knowing or not having information
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [01:16]

sentence: And the reason is that, behind the veil of ignorance, everyone knows that, once the veil goes up and real life begins, we will each want to be respected with dignity.
sentence_cn: 原因在于，在无知之幕背后，每个人都知道，一旦无知之幕升起、现实生活开始，我们每个人都希望得到有尊严的对待。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 尊严是道德哲学核心概念，涉及人的内在价值与尊重。
def_en: the quality of deserving respect and being treated with honor
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:13]

sentence: Even if we turn out to be a member of a minority, we don't want to be oppressed.
sentence_cn: 即使我们最终成为少数群体的一员，我们也不希望受压迫。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 受压迫是正义理论中讨论弱势群体与权利保障的关键词。
def_en: treated in a cruel and unfair way by people with power
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:35]

sentence: And so, we would agree to reject utilitarianism and, instead, to adopt, as our first principle, equal basic liberties, fundamental rights to freedom of speech, freedom of assembly, religious liberty, freedom of conscience, and the like.
sentence_cn: 因此，我们会同意拒绝功利主义，转而采纳平等的基本自由作为我们的第一原则，即言论自由、集会自由、宗教自由、良心自由等基本权利。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 基本自由是罗尔斯第一正义原则的核心内容。
def_en: basic rights and freedoms that all people should have
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:44]

sentence: And so, we would agree to reject utilitarianism and, instead, to adopt, as our first principle, equal basic liberties, fundamental rights to freedom of speech, freedom of assembly, religious liberty, freedom of conscience, and the like.
sentence_cn: 因此，我们会同意拒绝功利主义，转而采纳平等的基本自由作为我们的第一原则，即言论自由、集会自由、宗教自由、良心自由等基本权利。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 良心自由是基本自由之一，涉及道德与宗教自由。
def_en: an inner moral faculty enabling one to distinguish right from wrong
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [02:44]

sentence: We wouldn't want to take the chance that we would wind up as members of an oppressed, or a despised, minority, with the majority tyrannizing over us.
sentence_cn: 我们不会愿意冒险让自己最终成为受压迫、受鄙视的少数群体的一员，任由多数人对我们施行暴政。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 暴政是政治哲学中讨论权力滥用与压迫的重要概念。
def_en: ruling over people in a cruel and oppressive way
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:07]

sentence: Utilitarianism makes the mistake, Rawls writes, of forgetting, or, at least, not taking seriously, the distinction between persons.
sentence_cn: 罗尔斯写道，功利主义的错误在于忘记了，或者至少没有认真对待，人与人之间的分别。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 人的区分是罗尔斯批判功利主义的关键论点。
def_en: a clear difference made between two or more things
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [03:31]

sentence: Second principle has to do with social and economic inequalities.
sentence_cn: 第二条原则涉及社会和经济的不平等。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 社会与经济不平等是分配正义的核心议题。
def_en: unfair differences in wealth, status, or opportunities
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [04:02]

sentence: Remember, we don't know whether we're going to wind up being rich or poor, healthy or unhealthy. We don't know what kind of family we're going to come from, whether we're going to inherit millions or whether we will come from an impoverished family.
sentence_cn: 记住，我们不知道自己最终会变得富有还是贫穷，健康还是不健康。我们不知道自己会出身于什么样的家庭，是会继承数百万家产，还是来自一个贫困的家庭。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 贫困家庭是讨论分配正义时常见的背景因素。
def_en: very poor and lacking money or basic resources
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [04:11]

sentence: Rawls calls it the difference principle.
sentence_cn: 罗尔斯称之为差别原则。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 差别原则是罗尔斯正义论的第二原则，核心术语。
def_en: the way in which two or more things are not the same
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [05:06]

sentence: A principle that says, only those social and economic inequalities will be permitted that work to the benefit of the least-well off.
sentence_cn: 这条原则说的是，只有那些能让处境最差的人受益的社会和经济不平等，才会被允许。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 在正义原则中，允许何种不平等是关键论证环节。
def_en: to be officially allowed or accepted according to a rule or principle
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [05:10]

sentence: Only if they were part of a system, those wage differentials, that actually work to the advantage of the least-well off.
sentence_cn: 只有当这些工资差异是一个体系的组成部分，而这个体系实际上有利于最弱势群体时，才行。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 工资差异是讨论经济不平等时的具体表现。
def_en: differences in the amount of pay people receive for similar work
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [06:16]

sentence: Maybe it turns out that, as a practical matter, you have to provide incentives, to attract the right people to certain jobs.
sentence_cn: 也许事实证明，从实际角度出发，你必须提供激励，才能吸引合适的人去做某些工作。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 激励是论证差别原则时解释不平等如何惠及最差者的关键。
def_en: things that encourage people to do something or work harder
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [06:29]

sentence: AUDIENCE: In that situation, I would say a merit-based one. One where I don't necessarily know, but I'd rather have a system that rewards me based on my efforts.
sentence_cn: 观众：在那种情况下，我会说选择一种基于优绩的制度。一种我未必了解的制度，但我宁愿要一个根据我的努力来奖励我的制度。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: merit-based 是讨论分配正义时与平等相对的重要原则。
def_en: a good quality or achievement that deserves reward or recognition
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [08:12]

sentence: It shouldn't be based on factors that are arbitrary, from a moral point of view.
sentence_cn: 它不应该建立在从道德角度看是任意的因素之上。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 道德上任意是罗尔斯论证不应基于无法掌控因素的核心概念。
def_en: based on random choice or personal whim rather than reason or system
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:13]

sentence: He begins with the theory of justice that most everyone these days would reject, a feudal aristocracy.
sentence_cn: 他从如今几乎人人都会拒绝的一种正义理论开始，那就是封建贵族统治。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 封建贵族制是罗尔斯讨论正义理论时首先批判的分配制度。
def_en: a social class of people with high rank and special privileges

sentence: What's wrong with the allocation of life prospects in a feudal aristocracy?
sentence_cn: 在封建贵族统治下，对人生前景的分配有什么问题？
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 生活前景是分配正义讨论中衡量机会与结果的重要概念。
def_en: the chances or possibilities that someone will have for success or a good life in the future
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:41]

sentence: Well, the thing that's obviously wrong about it is that people's life prospects are determined by the accident of birth-- are you born to a noble family or to the family of peasants and serfs-- and that's it.
sentence_cn: 嗯，它明显的问题在于，人们的生活前景是由出生的偶然性决定的——你是出生在贵族家庭，还是出生在农民和农奴的家庭——就是这样。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 出生偶然是罗尔斯论证道德任意性的关键例子。
def_en: a chance event that happens without being planned or intended
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [12:50]

sentence: And so, that objection to a feudal aristocracy leads, and historically has led, people to say, careers should be open to talents.
sentence_cn: 因此，对封建贵族的这种反对意见导致——而且在历史上确实导致了——人们说，职业应当向有才能的人开放。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 才能是讨论分配正义时关于应得与道德任意性的核心概念。
def_en: natural abilities or skills that make someone suitable for a particular role
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [13:16]

sentence: There should be formal equality of opportunity, regardless of the accident of birth.

sentence: By trying to make sense of why he thinks that principles of justice are best derived from a hypothetical contract.

sentence: And that's, really, the system that Mike was advocating, earlier on, what we might call a merit-based system, a meritocratic system.

why: 罗尔斯论证中关键的制度类型，与公平机会原则紧密相关。

sentence: In a fair meritocracy, the society sets up institutions to bring everyone to the same starting point before the race begins.

sentence: Even that, he says, doesn't go far enough in remedying, or addressing, the moral arbitrariness of the natural lottery.

sentence: So Rawls says, even the principle of meritocracy, where you bring everyone to the same starting point, may eliminate the influence of social contingencies.

sentence: But even with formal equality of opportunity, the libertarian conception doesn't extend that, doesn't extend its insight, far enough.
sentence_cn: 但即便有了形式上的机会平等，自由至上主义的观念也没有把这一点、没有把它的洞见推得足够远。
speaker: Prof. Michael Sandel
why: 政治哲学中常指对正义、自由等概念的特定理解。
def_en: an idea or understanding of what something is or should be
scene_desc: 哈佛《公正》课堂现场 · 时间戳 [14:09]

sentence: But what you do is you change the terms on which people are entitled to the fruits of the exercise of those talents.
sentence_cn: 但你要做的是改变人们有权享有这些才能施展成果的条件。

why: 涉及分配正义中权利与应得的核心概念。
def_en: having the right to have or receive something
